question: What siddhis arise such as distant hearing and paralysis of bonds?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is mentioned as an attainment
Paralysis of bonds is mentioned likewise
These are presented as results of the practice
inference: The practice yields powers such as distant hearing and the paralysis of bonds
uncertainties: pāśa-stobha may mean arresting fetters or stunning enemies depending on context
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
